preconditions.expression: all(c in {'4', '7'} for c in N)
preconditions.description: Every character in the input string N must be either '4' or '7'.
The length of the input string N must be at least 1 and less than 50.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for length in range(1, len(N) + 1) for _ in range(2 ** length)) + int(N, 8) - 1
postconditions.description: The returned position is the 1-based index of N in the series, where the series is ordered by length (ascending) and lexicographical order (ascending) for each length. The formula computes the sum of all numbers with lengths less than len(N) (each length contributes 2^length numbers) and adds the 0-based lexicographical rank of N (interpreted as a base-8 number with digits 4→0 and 7→1).
